sm89.note: Ada. Two SMs per TPC (even/odd pair, SM 2k and 2k+1), one traversal unit per TPC (Throughput_8, Memory_5: measured on RTX 6000 Ada). Block placement with one block per SM: block b on SM 2b for b < SMs/2, then the odd SMs (measured on RTX 6000 Ada; re-measured per GPU by probe_placement.cu before any use).

sm120.note: Blackwell consumer (RTX 5090, GB202, 170 SMs, 96 MB L2), added 2026-11-19 on tgrogers-pc14 (shared desktop, GPU 0 drives the display). SMs per TPC 2 is ASSUMED (public GB202 layout, 85 TPCs); the only evidence here is that blocks always land on the SM pairs (2k, 2k+1) in consecutive order (probe_smid.cu, 6 launches identical). The Ada block placement rule does NOT hold (probe_placement: 825 mismatches over 5 launches): blocks go to the pairs 0,22,44,66,88,110,132, then 2,24,...; see notes/protocol.md SM120. No TTU run has been made on this GPU. Encodings: Cesar's data/encodings/ttu_sm120.json.
